title: Mixed-support native maximal-order partition
objective: Partition mixed maximal-order support so all certified word primes use one complete native batch and only arbitrary primes use exact polygon fallback

oracles: mixed-support exact lattice and global certificate

handoff.summary: Mixed proven support is partitioned at the existing native capability boundary. All word primes are submitted as one complete native batch and only primes above UWORD_MAX enter the exact polygon fallback. Trace evidence records resolved/deferred counts and the explicit partition. A mixed-support regression traps word-prime finite-field selection, checks the exact global lattice and witnesses, and rejects a corrupted lattice. Fresh timeout-corpus probes improved vector 139 from 23.244s to 1.829s, vector 168 from 16.084s to 4.652s, and vector 314 from over 30s to 2.589s.
risks: The broad pnpm test:native lane check is known to fail on the b315060d base because of unrelated FFLAS expectation and stale production-kernel cache drift recorded by nf-timeout-selector; focused native-backed maximal-order tests and strict Python checks pass.
The capability partition applies only to auto/native dispatch. Explicit polygon/Round4/Round2 requests retain their requested differential paths and costs.
next_steps: Integrate this commit before adding any public maximal-order hook that overlaps the native dispatch block.
Regenerate the timeout delta after integration; the three sampled former timeouts now complete well below five seconds with exact corpus results.
